searchText: The expectation is that miners will double the gas limit around the fork block. How big will the largest possible block be then? 30M Is the expectation that most blocks will contain 30M worth of gas? I presume it will start to get expensive fast if they are larger than 15m isnt that when the exponential fee increase kicks in? 🍿 On average, blocks will end up being 50% full (15M gas) for the reason you say Kinda misleading to say miners will double the gas limit then 🙂 I was getting really excited Would it be possible to "DDoS" by keeping blocks artificially full so that basefee stays high? would such an attack exist? It seems like blocks that are alomost 50% full could be sniped and filled up preventing basefee from dropping at least the next block. But it might not make much sense for anyone to do that you guys have already thought about these things 😄 i will leave you alone. 🙏 for ETH :> If you have money to spare, you're free to go ahead and burn it if you want to keep the base fee high It would cost a *massive* amount of money to fill blocks for an extended period. The rate the cost increases is very fast. You might be able to do minutes worth in a row before you are broke, assuming you started very wealthy. 🙂 If you started with a base fee of 1 Gwei and continuously had full blocks the gas fee would get so high that a single full block would consume all ETH in existence in 194 blocks (just under 42 minutes). Hmm, interesting fact! I didn't know it would get quite *that* high and quite *that* fast. see info here https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1Ld4JSyaz-gvTx-4xIaxe4qU2wlaG1XAQfMiKl9CKCY0/edit#gid=0 and here: https://twitter.com/trent_vanepps/status/1416039650393788416?s=20 wow, maybe I should make a chart just for that! I had it already for Goerli, <@!420951281910284289>. I can share for mainnet in 1 sec I get 170 blocks to burn everything: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1hLuXSZ9jsQaWqI502MtuEL7K93oZAaBYaSx61aqwUX8/edit?usp=sharing is your increase rate rounded to 1.13? Nope, just a bad view. Fixed Hardhat Release v2.5.0: https://github.com/nomiclabs/hardhat/releases/tag/hardhat-core-v2.5.0 Ecosystem Tracker Updated: https://github.com/ethereum/eth1.0-specs/blob/master/network-upgrades/ecosystem-readiness.md My numbers are different from <@552133098075193354> because I calculated for burning all ETH in a single block and used a 15M gas limit absent mindedly. Web3.js release v1.5.0-rc.0 : https://github.com/ChainSafe/web3.js/releases/tag/v1.5.0-rc.0 Ecosystem Tracker Updated: https://github.com/ethereum/eth1.0-specs/blob/master/network-upgrades/ecosystem-readiness.md
